title: Geometry - Lesson 3 Assessment: Volume of Cubes
description: Use side length and unit-cube models to calculate cube volume.

questions.question: A cube has side length 2 cm. What is its volume?
A cube has side length 5 cm. What is its volume? Enter just the number.
A unit cube represents one cubic unit of volume.
questions.explanation: A unit cube is one cube used to measure one cubic unit of space.

questions.question: A cube has side length 7 m. What is its volume?
A cube has 16 unit cubes in each layer and 4 layers. What is its volume? Enter just the number.
A student says a cube with side length 8 cm has volume 64 cm². What is the mistake?
questions.correctAnswer: The student found the area of one face using 8² instead of volume using 8³. The volume is 512 cm³.
questions.explanation: 64 cm² is face area. Cube volume is 8 × 8 × 8 = 512 cm³.

questions.question: Which unit is suitable for the volume of a cube with side length measured in centimeters?
questions.explanation: Volume uses cubic units, so centimeters become cubic centimeters.

questions.question: A cube has side length 9 units. Find its volume and explain the multiplication.
questions.explanation: A cube has equal length, width, and height, so multiply the side length three times.

questions.question: A cube has volume 64 cubic units. What side length could it have?
questions.explanation: The side length is the number that multiplies by itself three times to make 64.
